integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically from the top chain complex of the order-complex join; exact enumeration independently checks three small weak orders.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes \(h\ge2\) and every level has cardinality at least \(2\).
Only top integral homology is classified; full homotopy data are not.
Finite enumeration is only a consistency check.
title: Top homology detects level structure in finite weak orders
